item.title: Fundamental Movement Skills Research from 2000 to 2025: A Bibliometric Analysis with Pedagogical Interpretation
item.description: Background. Fundamental Movement Skills (FMS) are widely recognized as a foundation for physical activity, motor development, and sport participation. item.title: Maintaining Academic Success and Athletic Activities Together "Under the Shadow of Exam Stress"
item.description: Background. The university entrance exam preparation process creates cognitive and physical fatigue and time management challenges for student athletes. For student-athletes, these demands are compounded by the need to simultaneously maintain intensive training and competitive sport participation. item.title: The Impact of Science Practical Work Management Practices on Student Learning Outcomes
item.description: Objectives. This study examined the impact of science practical work management practices on student learning outcomes in public secondary schools in Tanzania.
